label: leader or organizational head of
definition: Person X holds or held a leadership or head office in political body or organization Y.
scope_notes: Preserves prior leader/head scope, including legislative leadership and explicit president/chair office. Simple membership, founding, affiliation, legal representation or an athletic lead does not qualify.

facts.reason: Harding is explicitly head of and leads Liberal Party.
Raske is explicitly Greater New York Hospital Association president/head.
Franks is explicitly United States Central Command head in both supplied rows.
Harazin is explicitly Mets president; negotiator and salary negotiation are different meanings.
Kristol is identified only as Weekly Standard editor. The supplied path does not establish an organizational head/leadership office under the declared scope.
